details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K7, and K8 are fully represented with supporting sentences. K5 (real estate development details) and K6 (cash flow details) are missing entirely. The summary captures the main financial performance, operational challenges, segment breakdown, and personnel changes, but lacks specific cash flow data and real estate project progress details, which are HIGH importance criteria. This results in a 'Generally yes' rating because most core material is present, but two high-importance items are missing.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is generally coherent with no material internal contradictions or logical gaps. All statements logically follow one another, with clear cause-and-effect relationships (e.g., operational disruptions and rising energy costs leading to profitability deterioration). The organization is logical, progressing from revenue performance to profitability, balance sheet, and outlook. There is no unnecessary repetition, and while segment figures (S2) and consolidated revenue (S1) are both reported as 1.86 million euros, this is not an internal contradiction because the candidate does not claim they are additive components of the same total. The summary forms a coherent whole without logical gaps or self-contradictions.
